text:
olivia: Cutting an RC tag now — rc-4204204200. Build green, quick smoke ok. Opening a short greenroom window 23:00-23:30 UTC. Need ops + QA ack before we promote to prod.

dev-deploy-bot: Artifact created: rc-4204204200. image=gcr.io/redwood/serve:v1.9.3-rc SHA=abc123def. Staging canary -> 5 pods.

nina: QA smoke sweep done, three minor model-answer diffs on edge prompts, not blocking. added notes to the ticket.

raf: Quick perf check: p95 +3% on long-chat tests, overall within tolerance. KV warmup looks OK.

oncall-aaron: I'll monitor. Abort criteria: error-rate > 1% sustained for 5m OR p95 > 2x baseline. I'll call abort if seen.

olivia: Rollback plan in docs: /runbooks/rc-rollback.md -> steps: 1) deploy previous image v1.9.2 2) shift traffic back over 2m 3) invalidate new kv entries. Keep that handy.

liam: Release notes draft: https://redwood.internal/release-notes/4204204200 — includes batching tweak + kv cache behavior change.

sherpa: Proposed promo cadence: stage A=5% (10m), B=30% (15m), C=100% (5m). Automated metric checks between stages, manual hold allowed. :ok_hand:

olivia: Starting stage A in ~5 mins. Deploy command (ops):
```
curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/promote -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"tag":"rc-4204204200","stages":[5,30,100],"stagger_minutes":[10,15,5]}'
```

dev-deploy-bot: Promotion kicked: stage=1 target=5% start_ts=4204204205

nina: Watching logs — no new 5xx in first 3m. :thumbsup:

raf: KV hit rate ramping as expected, p95 stable.

oncall-aaron: Noted small spike at 23:15 UTC: error-rate peaked 1.8% for ~2m, investigating.

olivia: If that persists to 5m we abort and roll back. Any signs of root cause?

liam: Traces point to /v1/chat path, parser edge-case on empty system messages causing NPE in rare prompts. Patch exists but risky to apply mid-promo.

nina: Agreed — prefer rollback if spike continues.

oncall-aaron: Spike dropped to 0.4% now. Holding watch for another 10m.

sherpa: Moving to stage B in 2m.

dev-deploy-bot: stage=2 target=30% start_ts=4204204260

olivia: Monitoring dashboards, latency and errors look within thresholds. Proceeding to final push after stage B stability.

dev-deploy-bot: stage=3 target=100% start_ts=4204204290

dev-deploy-bot: Promotion complete. final_image=gcr.io/redwood/serve:v1.9.3-rc SHA=abc123def promo_ts=4204204299 :tada:

olivia: Marking rc-4204204200 as promoted to prod candidate. We'll watch for 24h before pinning as stable. Opening follow-up for any post-promote regressions.

oncall-aaron: I'll own 24h watch and post any anomalies to #eng-oncall.

liam: Finalizing and publishing release notes + changelog.

nina: QA will run extended regression overnight and report any findings in morning.

olivia: Thanks everyone — nice coordinated push. :rocket:
